captureSet: Picvium 1.0.2 public page and README captures
method: Production Release assemblies from the same 2026-10-17 build as the distributed Picvium.exe, run in an isolated native Windows Avalonia capture harness. Each file is a lossless RenderTargetBitmap client visual at the actual 150% monitor scaling, saved as PNG. No OS input, no Computer Use screenshots, no retouching, resampling or reconstructed interface text. Editor captures omit the native Windows caption.
environment: Korean UI; default settings in an isolated profile; APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA and TEMP redirected to the development temp folder

gpuDisplay: upscale.png shows "GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090" at the copyright holder's request (2026-10-18). The capture PC has an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER, so the harness supplied this Vulkan device result to the production dialog instead of running the live probe. The line is still rendered by the application; no pixels were edited.

unchangedCapture.note: Batch conversion dialog (SAMPLE_01.jpg queued, output field set to the public Pictures/Converted folder, no conversion). A 1.0.2 rerun on 2026-10-18 produced identical pixels, so the original file is kept.
